lines.zh: 翅膀一振，我就浮起来走
lines.en: A beat of my wings and I walk on air.

lines.zh: 尾巴在身后拖着，扫过草丛
lines.en: My tail trails behind, sweeping the grass.

lines.zh: 壳上那些斑点，走起来会晃
lines.en: The spots on my shell shift as I walk.

lines.zh: 我走路带风，草都朝一边倒
lines.en: I carry wind when I walk; the grass bends one way.

lines.zh: 不急，一边走一边挑人
lines.en: No hurry; I pick my prey as I go.

lines.zh: 脚不落地，声音也就没了
lines.en: My feet don't touch ground, so there's no sound.

lines.zh: 三倍音速也不算什么
lines.en: Three times the speed of sound is nothing.

lines.zh: 在这片野地里，我算最干净的
lines.en: In this wild place, I'm the cleanest thing.

lines.zh: 翅膜嗡了一下，飞高半格
lines.en: My wing membrane buzzes and I rise half a block.

lines.zh: 我的影子是斜的，因为我在飘
lines.en: My shadow lies at an angle because I float.

lines.zh: 地不平，我干脆不走地
lines.en: The ground's uneven, so I don't use it.

lines.zh: 走远些，别让尾巴碰到你
lines.en: Keep back, or my tail will brush you.

lines.zh: 我数过这附近所有的气
lines.en: I've counted every ki signature around here.

lines.zh: 站着不动，翅膀还在轻颤
lines.en: Standing still, my wings still quiver.

lines.zh: 这条尾巴是我的，也是我的嘴
lines.en: This tail is mine, and it's also my mouth.

lines.zh: 壳上的斑点不脏，是花纹
lines.en: The spots on my shell aren't dirt, they're a pattern.

lines.zh: 我在等一个人变强
lines.en: I'm waiting for someone to get stronger.

lines.zh: 世界这么小，不够我玩
lines.en: The world is so small, not enough to play in.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸浅，几乎听不见
lines.en: My breath is shallow, almost inaudible.

lines.zh: 站着的时候，我在算距离
lines.en: While standing, I'm calculating distance.

lines.zh: 尾尖在泥地上画圈
lines.en: My tail tip draws circles in the mud.

lines.zh: 你们这些活物，太吵
lines.en: You living things are too loud.

lines.zh: 我不需要休息，但也没别的事
lines.en: I don't need rest, and there's nothing else to do.

lines.zh: 太阳照在壳上，有点烫
lines.en: Sun on my shell, a little hot.

lines.zh: 把尾巴盘起来，坐等
lines.en: I coil my tail and sit and wait.

lines.zh: 安静，让我听清远处的心跳
lines.en: Quiet, let me hear the distant heartbeats.

lines.zh: 你身上有点料，够我尝一口
lines.en: You've got something in you, enough for a taste.

lines.zh: 别背对我，那很没礼貌
lines.en: Don't turn your back, it's rude.

lines.zh: 我看你不像本地人
lines.en: You don't look like you're from here.

lines.zh: 你的气，比刚才强了一点
lines.en: Your ki is a little stronger than before.

lines.zh: 把手抬起来，让我看看
lines.en: Raise your hands, let me see.

lines.zh: 你这么小，也敢站这么近
lines.en: So small, and you stand this close.

lines.zh: 我不吃人，我只吸能量
lines.en: I don't eat people, I only drain energy.

lines.zh: 说句话吧，我喜欢听人求饶
lines.en: Say something; I like hearing pleas.

lines.zh: 这条尾巴比你的刀快
lines.en: This tail is faster than your blade.

lines.zh: 再站稳一点，别抖
lines.en: Stand firmer, stop shaking.

lines.zh: 你在算能不能跑，我算过了
lines.en: You're wondering if you can run; I already did the math.

lines.zh: 眼睛别乱看，看我就好
lines.en: Don't let your eyes wander, look at me.

lines.zh: 我对你的名字没兴趣
lines.en: I have no interest in your name.

lines.zh: 你能站着，是因为我允许
lines.en: You still stand because I allow it.

lines.zh: 你的骨头里有气，闻着不错
lines.en: There's ki in your bones, smells fine.

lines.zh: 别害怕，我动作很快
lines.en: Don't be afraid; I'm quick.

lines.zh: 这么近，我闻得到你的心跳
lines.en: This close, I can hear your heart.

lines.zh: 壳裂了一道，能修
lines.en: A crack in my shell, it'll mend.

lines.zh: 疼，但这具身体不怕疼
lines.en: It hurts, but this body doesn't fear it.

lines.zh: 我闪开了一半，另一半没躲掉
lines.en: I dodged half; the other half landed.

lines.zh: 这点伤，我算过
lines.en: I accounted for this much damage.

lines.zh: 预判错了，下次不会
lines.en: I predicted wrong; it won't happen twice.

lines.zh: 血是绿的，别大惊小怪
lines.en: My blood is green, don't make a fuss.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，重新算距离
lines.en: I take half a step and recalculate.

lines.zh: 这一下，让我更想吸你
lines.en: That makes me want to drain you more.

lines.zh: 壳能再生，你不必高兴
lines.en: My shell regenerates, don't celebrate.

lines.zh: 身体在响，是在修复
lines.en: The sound in me is repair.

lines.zh: 能量，我只对能量有兴趣
lines.en: Energy; only energy interests me.

lines.zh: 你手里那点东西，填不饱我
lines.en: That little thing in your hand won't fill me.

lines.zh: 给我一颗仙豆，我考虑放过你
lines.en: Give me a senzu and I'll consider sparing you.

lines.zh: 吸一口，比吃一口省事
lines.en: A sip is easier than a bite.

lines.zh: 你把气放出来，我自然过去
lines.en: Let your ki out, and I'll come to it.

lines.zh: 食物？我早不靠这个
lines.en: Food? I stopped relying on that long ago.

lines.zh: 你在拿肉钓我，太天真
lines.en: You're dangling meat at me; naive.

lines.zh: 那团光不错，给我
lines.en: That ball of light, hand it over.

lines.zh: 我要的是你的气，不是你的手
lines.en: I want your ki, not your hands.

lines.zh: 拿东西来换命，倒是可以
lines.en: Trading goods for your life, that could work.

lines.zh: 别贴着壳，那有棱
lines.en: Don't press against my shell, it has ridges.

lines.zh: 我这身壳是硬的，你不是
lines.en: My shell is hard; you aren't.

lines.zh: 让路，我不绕人
lines.en: Make way, I don't go around people.

lines.zh: 碰一下，你就退了三步
lines.en: One touch and you're three steps back.

lines.zh: 尾巴扫过去了，站稳
lines.en: My tail swept past; keep your feet.

lines.zh: 撞我的翅膀，你会听见嗡
lines.en: Hit my wing and you'll hear it buzz.

lines.zh: 离我半格，这是规矩
lines.en: Half a block from me, that's the rule.

lines.zh: 擦肩而过，算你运气
lines.en: Passing shoulder to shoulder, consider yourself lucky.

lines.zh: 同类？我还没遇到能配的
lines.en: My kind? I haven't met one worth it.

lines.zh: 我得先变成完全体
lines.en: I must become perfect first.

lines.zh: 两个沙鲁碰面，只会互相吸
lines.en: Two Cells meeting would only drain each other.

lines.zh: 我不需要伴，只需要吸收
lines.en: I need no partner, only absorption.

lines.zh: 尾巴对上尾巴，未必是好事
lines.en: Tail to tail, that isn't necessarily good.

lines.zh: 另一个我，倒是可以聊聊
lines.en: Another me, now that could be worth a talk.

lines.zh: 繁殖这种事，交给弱者
lines.en: Breeding is for the weak.

lines.zh: 我把这当成一种交易
lines.en: I treat this as a transaction.

lines.zh: 别围观，这里没你的份
lines.en: Don't watch, there's no part for you here.

lines.zh: 时候到了，我自然会找
lines.en: When the time comes, I'll look.

lines.zh: 掉下来的东西，先归我
lines.en: Fallen things come to me first.

lines.zh: 我不弯腰，尾巴一卷就起来
lines.en: I don't bend over; my tail curls it up.

lines.zh: 这点材料，对我没用
lines.en: This material is useless to me.

lines.zh: 捡起来，只是顺手
lines.en: I pick it up, just in passing.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的能量，浪费了
lines.en: Spilled energy on the ground, what a waste.

lines.zh: 这颗豆子，我留着
lines.en: This bean, I'll keep.

lines.zh: 东西归我，命归你
lines.en: The thing is mine, your life is yours.

lines.zh: 我拿走不代表需要
lines.en: My taking it doesn't mean I need it.

lines.zh: 尾尖勾住，收进壳缝
lines.en: My tail tip hooks it into a seam.

lines.zh: 你看我捡东西的样子，很奇怪吗
lines.en: Is it strange to watch me pick things up?

lines.zh: 有个气在远处亮起来
lines.en: A ki signature lit up in the distance.

lines.zh: 这个不错，气够浓
lines.en: This one's good, the ki is thick.

lines.zh: 我闻到了，就往那边去
lines.en: I caught the scent; I'm headed there.

lines.zh: 先升空，看清楚再动
lines.en: I rise first to see clearly before moving.

lines.zh: 那个人站得很稳，有点意思
lines.en: That one stands steady, a little interesting.

lines.zh: 尾巴已经指着方向了
lines.en: My tail already points the way.

lines.zh: 距离合适，起手就快
lines.en: Good range; my opener will be quick.

lines.zh: 气血在动，还在涨
lines.en: Their ki is moving, still rising.

lines.zh: 我先试一下，看看深浅
lines.en: I'll probe first to gauge them.

lines.zh: 就他了，别的人太弱
lines.en: That one; the rest are too weak.

lines.zh: 翅膀一收，我准备扑
lines.en: I fold my wings and ready the pounce.

lines.zh: 这个身体的力气，够一次
lines.en: This body has strength for one good strike.

lines.zh: 锁定了，气跑不掉
lines.en: Locked on; ki can't escape.

lines.zh: 那边有两个人，我挑强的
lines.en: Two over there; I'll take the stronger.

lines.zh: 先看看他会什么招
lines.en: First, let's see what he can do.

lines.zh: 眼睛盯住了，就不移开
lines.en: My eyes are on him and won't move.

lines.zh: 我升到高处，从上面压下去
lines.en: I climb high to press down from above.

lines.zh: 他退，我就追，追得比他快
lines.en: He retreats, I chase, and I'm faster.

lines.zh: 小气弹先来一发
lines.en: A small ki blast to start.

lines.zh: 这个距离，尾巴够不着
lines.en: Too far for the tail at this range.

lines.zh: 绕到背后，那是最省力的角度
lines.en: Circle behind; that's the cheapest angle.

lines.zh: 他的气乱了，快撑不住
lines.en: His ki is scrambled; he's nearly done.

lines.zh: 我留一手，看他有没有后招
lines.en: I hold one back to see if he has more.

lines.zh: 太阳拳会让他闭眼
lines.en: The Solar Flare will shut his eyes.

lines.zh: 龟派气功得蓄一下
lines.en: The Kamehameha needs a moment to charge.

lines.zh: 他在准备什么，我看得见
lines.en: I can see he's preparing something.

lines.zh: 先躲，再打，别硬碰
lines.en: Dodge first, strike after, don't clash.

lines.zh: 这个身法有破绽，我看清了
lines.en: That stance has a gap, and I've seen it.

lines.zh: 地面比空中好打
lines.en: The ground is easier than the air.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，从下面切进去
lines.en: I drop low and cut in from beneath.

lines.zh: 他跳起来了，正好
lines.en: He jumped, just right.

lines.zh: 火候到了，别再拖
lines.en: The moment is ripe; no more delay.

lines.zh: 我数着他落地的位置
lines.en: I'm counting where he'll land.

lines.zh: 这一拳要打在他反应之前
lines.en: This punch must land before he reacts.

lines.zh: 拳头砸在护甲上，声音很闷
lines.en: My fist lands on armor with a dull sound.

lines.zh: 翅膀后一振，连击跟上来
lines.en: A backward wingbeat and the combo follows.

lines.zh: 尾巴抽过去，像鞭子
lines.en: My tail lashes out like a whip.

lines.zh: 这一膝盖顶进他胸口
lines.en: This knee drives into his chest.

lines.zh: 小气弹近距离炸开
lines.en: A small ki blast bursts at close range.

lines.zh: 太阳拳——现在看不见了吧
lines.en: Solar Flare, now you can't see.

lines.zh: 从上方砸下来，压着他打
lines.en: I slam down from above and keep the pressure on.

lines.zh: 连段第三下，他飞出去了
lines.en: Third strike of the combo sends him flying.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴缠住，吸一口气
lines.en: I coil my tail around and take a draw.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，下一组才重
lines.en: That was light; the next set is heavy.

lines.zh: 他挡得不错，可惜手慢了
lines.en: He blocked well, but too slow.

lines.zh: 龟派气功从掌心冲出去
lines.en: The Kamehameha bursts from my palms.

lines.zh: 我用肩撞，把他顶回墙里
lines.en: I ram with my shoulder and drive him into the wall.

lines.zh: 他的呼吸乱了，我接着上
lines.en: His breath breaks, so I press on.

lines.zh: 打完就退开，看他怎么站
lines.en: I strike and withdraw to see him rise.

lines.zh: 这具身体的极限，快到了
lines.en: This body is nearing its limit.

lines.zh: 命令一下，我就站在这里
lines.en: At the word, here I stand.

lines.zh: 空气里先有气，再有人影
lines.en: First the ki arrives, then the shape.

lines.zh: 我从胶囊里醒过来
lines.en: I wake out of the capsule.

lines.zh: 这是哪块地，气很杂
lines.en: What land is this? The ki is muddled.

lines.zh: 壳还没干透，我就想动了
lines.en: My shell hasn't dried and I already want to move.

lines.zh: 尾巴一落地，草就不动了
lines.en: My tail touches ground and the grass goes still.

lines.zh: 我不是自然生成的，你该知道
lines.en: I don't spawn naturally; you should know that.

lines.zh: 有人唤我出来，最好有理由
lines.en: Someone called me out; there'd better be a reason.

lines.zh: 这个世界的能量，稀薄得可笑
lines.en: The energy of this world is laughably thin.

lines.zh: 睁开眼，第一个看到的是天空
lines.en: I open my eyes and the first thing I see is sky.

lines.zh: 我还没完全体，先凑合
lines.en: I'm not perfect yet, but this will do.

lines.zh: 从无到有，用了一瞬间
lines.en: From nothing to something took an instant.

lines.zh: 这个身体的形状，我不太满意
lines.en: I'm not fond of this body's shape.

lines.zh: 羽毛还翘着，慢慢会顺
lines.en: My wing plates still stick up; they'll settle.

lines.zh: 我听到了心跳，很多个
lines.en: I hear heartbeats, many of them.

lines.zh: 任务、结构、命令，总有人放我出来
lines.en: Mission, structure, command; someone always lets me out.

lines.zh: 爪子落地，先试试力气
lines.en: My claws touch down; let's test my strength.

lines.zh: 我叫沙鲁，你记住这个名字
lines.en: I am Cell; remember the name.

lines.zh: 火烧不穿壳，只热了一下
lines.en: Fire won't pierce my shell, only warms it.

lines.zh: 落地时膝盖一沉，还好
lines.en: My knees buckled on landing, not bad.

lines.zh: 水里我还能呼吸，只是慢
lines.en: I can still breathe in water, just slower.

lines.zh: 炸开的气浪，推了我一程
lines.en: The blast wave carried me a distance.

lines.zh: 箭被壳弹开了
lines.en: The arrow glanced off my shell.

lines.zh: 法术想钻进我，被我挡出去
lines.en: The spell tried to enter me; I pushed it out.

lines.zh: 能量耗尽，这具身体会散
lines.en: Drained of energy, this body will come apart.

lines.zh: 雷顺着壳走，麻了一瞬
lines.en: Lightning ran over my shell and numbed me a moment.

lines.zh: 虚空没有气，我在这里最弱
lines.en: No ki in the void; here I am weakest.
